changelog: **Meeting attendance, part 2 (#2014):** ending a pair's meeting from the dashboard banner now asks "who was there?" (`AttendanceStep`, before the rating card; recurring occurrences included). Everyone defaults to attended and *Skip* records nothing. The relation record (`/mentor/mentees/[id]`, `/admin/candidates/[id]`) shows the pair's meeting rhythm and lets the mentor or an admin set it (`RelationCadencePanel`, `GET /api/mentorship/[id]/cadence`). `GET /api/meetings/[id]/attendance` now names the two participants.

en: When you end a meeting, you can now note who was there in one tap — and each mentorship shows whether the pair meets on the rhythm you agreed.
tr: Bir görüşmeyi bitirirken artık kimin katıldığını tek dokunuşla not edebilirsin — her mentorlukta da çiftin anlaşılan sıklıkta görüşüp görüşmediği görünüyor.
de: Wenn du ein Treffen beendest, kannst du jetzt mit einem Tipp festhalten, wer dabei war — und jedes Mentoring zeigt, ob sich das Paar im vereinbarten Rhythmus trifft.
